photo.title: 'Kuki. / Kuki cannon (burst) taken at Lapvomi' (handwritten caption). Close view at Lapvomi of a roll of tree bark and/or animal hide (probably from a mithan, ox) wound with hide bands, identified as (the barrel of) a 'cannon' of the Kuki people, presumably used in the Kuki Rising 1917-1919.
'Kouki' (handwritten caption). Portrait of a Kuki man wearing a waistcoat with lapels and a pale striped cloak, squatting in front of a white sheet that is being used as a backdrop.

Full-length portrait of two Kuki girls from Dulin (possibly the village of Dulen near Imphal), with their hair tied on top, outside the entrance to a house, each wearing a cloak over one shoulder, earrings, many bead necklaces, one bangle at the elbow, and many bangles on each wrist.
Close view from the front of a Kuki girl from Dulin (possibly the village of Dulen near Imphal), wearing a cloak and squatting to spin, using a frame with many arms to hold the thread.

View from the side of a Kuki girl of Dulin (possibly the village of Dulen near Imphal), sitting on a cleared hilltop and spinning, using a frame with many arms to hold the thread; and in the foreground a large gourd-shaped vessel.
